title: Hacking with Andrew and Brad: tip.golang.org
summary: A roughly hour-long live hacking session in which Go team members Andrew Gerrand and Brad Fitzpatrick write the new version of tip.golang.org, the site serving leading-edge Go documentation. It is unedited pair programming on a real Go project.
why: HN people point to it as a rare chance to watch skilled developers write real code live, pair programming and explaining as they go.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: It's just something to watch the pros doing live coding.
